title: [finding] any member who may open a published app reads its PENDING draft through the plain read's `?state=draft` and `?preview=draft`: no builder gate, though ADR-0037's Risks row and ADR-0106 D4 assume one
body:
Filing gate: **① a defect with a named landing site**, `packages/rest/src/rest-server.ts`: the plain read `GET /meta/:type/:name`, in its `?state=draft` and `?preview=draft` branches. Finding class **(b)**: a declared contract the transport does not honour. It is filed under the **security exception**, because it exposes unpublished authoring work. `reach:` was measured at a public door.

Found by the `os-dev` round on #20290 (PR #20337), and confirmed at source by that PR's at-tier contract review (record `5860832731`, out-of-scope item 1). Filed by the `domain:cli` execution seat (#6024, `session_01UYBdGBzWSrAMzpW8ah3GbP`). ⛔ Filed bare: routing and grading belong to triage. ⛔ Not a claim.

## What happens

- **Measured by the dev** on the real REST stack at `de091b50e`: a member with no Studio or Setup capability sent `GET /meta/app/NAME?state=draft` and `?preview=draft`. Both answered **200 with the pending draft**, pruned per caller.
- **At source (the review):**
  - the two branches (`rest-server.ts` about :6595-6603 and :6843-6858) run no authoring-capability check;
  - the transport's only such gate is `GET /meta/_drafts` (about :5655, `isObjectSchemaMaskExempt(ctx)` → 403 "requires an authoring capability");
  - `filterAppForUserWithReason` demands `studio.access`/`setup.access` only for `_unpublished` apps.
- **So:** unpublished edits to a published app, such as renamed or added navigation, or other draft-only changes, are readable by every member who may open that app.
- **Not changed by PR #20337:** that PR moves only the author exemption and the per-deployment arms on `?state=draft`.

## The contract it contradicts

- **ADR-0037 (Accepted), Risks row:** 「confirm/add a builder/admin role gate on the dispatcher reads」.
- **ADR-0106 D4:** 「draft/preview reads are admin-gated upstream already」. That is not true of the item read.
- **The protocol's `getMetaItem` comment:** 「admin-gated upstream」.

## Seam

`spec:ADR-0037 Risks (preview=draft exposure)` → `runtime:RestServer GET /meta/:type/:name ?state=draft / ?preview=draft`, plus `packages/runtime/src/domains/meta.ts`'s item read on `?preview=draft`.

## Scope question for triage (⛔ not presumed here)

Gating draft reads to builders is a permission boundary: who may read a draft at all. It is adjacent to, but separate from, #20290's decision (whether an author reads a draft whole). The two may be presented together.

## Dedupe

MCP issue search in this repository, run 2026-09-27: 「member without studio setup access reads pending draft via state=draft preview=draft, no builder gate on draft reads ADR-0037」 → 21 hits.
- #20290 (open) is the author-exemption card, the parent round.
- #7497 is approver visibility, which is unrelated.
- #11087, #7656, #8400, #20078, #17824 and #17951 are closed and unrelated.

None of them is this defect.

Dedupe words: `draft read builder gate` · `preview=draft exposure member` · `state=draft non-builder reads pending draft` · `ADR-0037 admin gate`
